$schema_note: Golden FedCode vectors generated by ciris-verify-core/tests/fedcode_vectors.rs from ciris_verify_core::fedcode (the CC 2.6.8 reference). Keys are sorted; regenerate with CIRIS_FEDCODE_VECTORS_REGENERATE=1. See README.md beside this file.

cases.description: The pulled key hashes to the code's commitment: admitted, both halves returned.
The pulled key differs from the commitment in one bit: refused (CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (a)).
A code with no commitment admits nothing: fails closed (CC 2.6.8: nothing to bind the pulled key to).

ml_dsa_65_pubkey_stand_in.description: A deterministic 1952-byte stand-in for a raw ML-DSA-65 public key: byte i = i mod 251. The vectors commit to its sha256; a port that cannot produce ML-DSA keys can still reproduce the commitment.

consumer_cases.description: A v2-only decoder MUST refuse `CIRIS-V3-` (and `CIRISV3`) before reading a payload byte (CC 2.6.8 constraint 5). ciris_verify_core exposes no v2-only decode path, so this is the consumer's test: feed each input to a v2-only decoder and require a prefix refusal, not a parse attempt.

known_disagreements.note: Where ciris_verify_core::fedcode departs from CC 2.6.8. Empty: the four departures recorded in v22.1.0 (unverified sha256(key_id), encoder-only payload bound, unreadable non-user commitment-only v3, tolerated missing group_key_id hint) were fixed in CIRISVerify#331 and their inputs now sit in `refusals` and `valid`.

material.ed25519: Every pubkey is ed25519-dalek's verifying key for the 32-byte seed shown (seed byte repeated 32 times).
material.ml_dsa_65_pubkey_stand_in: 1952 bytes, byte i = i mod 251; its sha256 is the commitment carried by every vector.

refusals.description: The same code with one more transport-hint byte: payload 1,025 bytes, refused by the encoder.
The commitment in uppercase hex is refused, not lowercased (CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (d)).
A 62-character commitment (31 bytes) is refused.
A 66-character commitment (33 bytes) is refused.
A 64-character commitment with a non-hex character is refused.
An empty commitment string is refused (absence is `None`, not the empty string).
17 owned nodes are refused by the encoder.
An embedded node whose transport key is the owner's own Ed25519 pubkey is refused.
A `agent` code embedding a node is refused; only `user` may embed nodes.
A `node` code embedding a node is refused; only `user` may embed nodes.
A `family` code embedding a node is refused; only `user` may embed nodes.
A `community` code embedding a node is refused; only `user` may embed nodes.
An owned node with an empty key_id is refused (LP fields in the tail are 1..=255 bytes).
An owned node whose transport key is not 32 raw bytes is refused.
A key_id of 256 bytes is refused (1-byte length prefix).
A transport hint of 256 bytes is refused.
An owner pubkey of 31 raw bytes is refused.

refusals.constraint: API: pubkey_ed25519_base64 is standard base64 of 32 raw bytes
refusals.description: An owner pubkey that is not base64 is refused.
The `v3_user_nodes_and_commitment` code with the first key_id byte flipped and the original CRC kept: checksum mismatch.

refusals.constraint: CC 2.6.8 constraint 5 (prefix read before any payload byte)
refusals.description: A `CIRIS-V9-` prefix is not a fedcode.
Text with no CIRIS prefix at all.
A bare prefix with no payload.
A body containing characters outside the RFC 4648 alphabet (0, 1, 8, 9).
96 bytes of sha256 output rendered as a v2 body: well-formed base32, not a payload.
The reference display code cut after its first group: too short to hold a payload.
The reference display code with its last two groups dropped: the bytes no longer end in their CRC.
The reference payload cut in the middle of the key_id with the CRC recomputed: the declared field length exceeds the buffer.
A v2 payload whose version byte is 0x04 under the v2 prefix, CRC recomputed.
A v2 payload whose kind byte is 6, CRC recomputed.
A v2 payload whose kind byte is 0, CRC recomputed.
A v3 payload declaring 17 nodes, CRC recomputed: refused by the decoder.
A v3 payload (minted elsewhere) whose embedded node transport key equals the owner's pubkey, CRC recomputed: refused by the decoder.
A v3 payload with kind `agent` and one embedded node, CRC recomputed: refused by the decoder.
The reference payload with the commitment presence tag set to 0x02, CRC recomputed.
The reference payload with the commitment cut to 16 bytes after its 0x01 tag, CRC recomputed.
A v2 payload whose key_id carries a 0xFF byte, CRC recomputed: LP fields are UTF-8.
A v2 payload whose key_id length prefix declares 255 bytes the buffer does not hold, CRC recomputed.

refusals.constraint: CC 2.6.8 wire format (a decoder MUST verify sha256(key_id) against key_id)
refusals.description: The `v2_user_hints` payload with its sha256(key_id) zeroed, CRC recomputed: the hash does not match the display key_id.

refusals.constraint: CC 2.6.8 wire format (a decoder MUST verify sha256(key_id) against key_id)
refusals.description: The `v2_user_hints` payload with the display key_id's first byte changed (`alice-…` to `mlice-…`), the minted sha256(key_id) kept and the CRC recomputed: refused.

refusals.constraint: CC 2.6.8 constraint 3 (payload <= 1024 bytes before base32, enforced at encoder AND decoder)
refusals.description: The `v3_user_payload_1024` payload with one more transport-hint byte (1,025 bytes), CRC recomputed: refused by the decoder as `enc_payload_1025` is by the encoder.

refusals.constraint: CC 2.6.8 wire format (hint(group_key_id) is 0x00 when absent, never omitted)
refusals.description: The `v2_user_hints` payload ending after hint(alias), its 0x00 group_key_id hint byte removed, CRC recomputed: truncated.

v2 `user` code with transport and alias hints.
v2 `agent` code: no hints, no group_key_id, no v3 tail.
v2 `agent` code with transport and alias hints.
v2 `node` code: no hints, no group_key_id, no v3 tail.
v2 `node` code with transport and alias hints.
v2 `family` code: no hints, no group_key_id, no v3 tail.
v2 `family` code with transport and alias hints and the group's key_id.
v2 `community` code: no hints, no group_key_id, no v3 tail.
v2 `community` code with transport and alias hints and the group's key_id.
v3 `user` code embedding one owned node; commitment absent (tag 0x00).
v3 `user` code with transport and alias hints and three owned nodes; commitment absent.
v3 `user` code carrying the PQC commitment and no nodes (node_count = 0): CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (b).
v3 `agent` code carrying the PQC commitment and no nodes (node_count = 0): the commitment applies to any kind (CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (b)); constraint 2 restricts only embedded nodes.
v3 `node` code carrying the PQC commitment and no nodes (node_count = 0): the commitment applies to any kind (CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (b)); constraint 2 restricts only embedded nodes.

v3 `family` code carrying the PQC commitment and no nodes (node_count = 0): the commitment applies to any kind (CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (b)); constraint 2 restricts only embedded nodes; carries the group's key_id.

v3 `community` code carrying the PQC commitment and no nodes (node_count = 0): the commitment applies to any kind (CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (b)); constraint 2 restricts only embedded nodes; carries the group's key_id.
v3 `user` code with hints, three owned nodes and the PQC commitment (tag 0x01 + 32 raw bytes, last).
v3 `user` code at the node bound: 16 owned nodes admitted (CC 2.6.8 constraint 3).
v3 `user` code whose payload is exactly 1,024 bytes before base32: admitted at the edge (CC 2.6.8 constraint 3).
A v3-capable encoder given an empty node list and no commitment emits the v2 code byte for byte (CC 2.6.8 constraint 4). Identical to `v2_user_bare`.

valid.construction: version=0x01 | sha256(key_id)(32) | pubkey(32) | LP(key_id) | 0x00 | 0x00; no kind byte, no group_key_id hint.
valid.description: Legacy v1 NodeCode (`CIRIS-V1-`), no hints: decodes as kind `node` (CC 2.6.8 constraint 5).

valid.construction: version=0x01 | sha256(key_id)(32) | pubkey(32) | LP(key_id) | LP(transport) | LP(alias).
valid.description: Legacy v1 NodeCode with transport and alias hints: decodes as kind `node`.

valid.construction: The `v3_user_nodes_1` payload with its trailing 0x00 commitment tag removed, CRC recomputed.
valid.description: A v3 code minted before the PQC commitment existed ends after the node list; it decodes with the commitment absent (CC 2.6.8 PQC rule (c)).

wire.base32: RFC 4648 alphabet A-Z2-7, no padding; display groups of 4 joined by '-', QR form ungrouped
wire.crc: CRC-16-CCITT, polynomial 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, no final xor, appended big-endian
wire.hint: 0x00 absent, else 1-byte length + UTF-8 (<= 255 bytes); order transport, alias, group_key_id
wire.v3_tail: node_count(1) 0..=16, node_count x [LP(node_key_id) | transport_ed25519(32)], then 0x00 | 0x01 + sha256(raw ML-DSA-65 pubkey)(32)
